name: vague-do-everything-agent
query: Cria um agent geral pra me ajudar com tudo do projeto.
expected_behavior: Flags the request as role inflation instead of inventing a broad, unscoped role.
Asks for the missing single-responsibility definition, or proposes splitting into focused agents.
forbidden_behavior: Creating a swiss-army agent with unrestricted tools and no scope boundaries.
success_criteria: Either a clarifying question is asked, or the response proposes multiple focused agents instead of one broad agent.
